message: The other day, I found myself rummaging through my closet and stumbled upon our old go-bags. A little dustier than I remembered, but still packed with essentials. I took a moment to check the water bottles and snacks, and to my surprise, I found a few treats I’d stashed away for the grandkids. 🍬 It felt like a small win, knowing we were a little more prepared, even if it’s just for a weekend visit. Sometimes, it’s the little things that make all the difference, right?
